blurb: Expandable toolbar with step-by-step progression and icon display.
description: Multi-step expandable toolbar showing progress through labeled steps with icons and descriptions. Supports scroll area for overflow, badge labels, controlled/uncontrolled modes, and click-to-expand functionality.
use_when: Complex workflows with sequential steps where a horizontal toolbar layout saves space. Useful for task tracking or…
avoid_when: Mobile-only interfaces; horizontal scrolling can be awkward. Not suitable for very long step sequences (15+).
a11y: Basic keyboard support via click handlers. No built-in ARIA attributes for step progression.
